name: PR416 no-StateMachine-pair focused

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-no-state-machine-pair
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-no-state-machine-pair.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  focused-regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        test_name:
          - AControlledCarrierIsActuallyDispossessed
          - BothOutcomesOccur_TheBallIsSometimesWonAndSometimesKnockedLoose
          - TacklesHappenInComposedPlay
          - ATackleFoulIsGivenAsASlideTackleAndNotJudgedTwice
          - sim_match_engine_shot_outcomes
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Verify pair-removal diff
        run: |
          git diff --check 07dcc670fed1ecc6aa32e9711d4bc8830c0ec2ad -- src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs
          git diff --exit-code 1bad655f5826070d1e29f54a845cdf2c549f66bc -- src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs || {
            echo 'BallStateMachine differs textually from pinned main; checking semantic diff excluding line endings'
            python3 - <<'PY'
          import subprocess
          current = open('src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs', newline=None).read()
          main = subprocess.check_output(['git','show','1bad655f5826070d1e29f54a845cdf2c549f66bc:src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs']).decode().replace('\r\n','\n')
          assert current.replace('\r\n','\n') == main, 'pair-removal file is not pinned-main BallStateMachine semantics'
          PY
          }
      - name: Generate projects and restore
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - name: Run focused MatchEngine target
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          out="artifacts/pr416-no-state-machine-pair-${{ matrix.test_name }}"
          mkdir -p "$out"
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=${{ matrix.test_name }}" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            --logger "trx;LogFileName=${{ matrix.test_name }}.trx" \
            --results-directory "$out" \
            2>&1 | tee "$out/console.log"
          dotnet_status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          python3 - "$out/${{ matrix.test_name }}.trx" "${{ matrix.test_name }}" <<'PY'
          import sys, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          path, name = sys.argv[1:]
          root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
          rows = [e for e in root.iter() if e.tag.endswith('UnitTestResult') and e.attrib.get('testName', '').endswith(name)]
          if len(rows) != 1:
              print(f'TARGET_RESULT {name} AMBIGUOUS count={len(rows)}')
              sys.exit(2)
          outcome = rows[0].attrib.get('outcome', '<missing>')
          print(f'TARGET_RESULT {name} {outcome}')
          if outcome != 'Passed':
              sys.exit(1)
          PY
          trx_status=$?
          if [ "$dotnet_status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$trx_status" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Upload focused evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-no-state-machine-pair-${{ matrix.test_name }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-no-state-machine-pair-${{ matrix.test_name }}/
          if-no-files-found: error

  controlled-residency:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Add temporary Controlled-residency measurement
        run: |
          cat > src/match-engine/tests/Pr416ControlledResidencyEvidenceTests.cs <<'CS'
          using NUnit.Framework;
          using TacticalDirector.BallPhysics;
          using TacticalDirector.DefensiveAI;
          using TacticalDirector.DeterministicSim;
          using TacticalDirector.PlayerDatabase;

          namespace TacticalDirector.MatchEngine
          {
              [TestFixture]
              internal sealed class Pr416ControlledResidencyEvidenceTests
              {
                  private const int Ticks = 150_000;
                  private static readonly ulong[] Seeds =
                  {
                      0x0F1E2D3C4B5A6978UL,
                      0x00000000D1A6D05EUL,
                  };

                  private static Squad BuildSquad(ulong seed, int clubId)
                  {
                      var rng = new DeterministicRngService(seed ^ (ulong)clubId);
                      int stream = rng.RegisterStream("tackle.roster", SubsystemOrdinals.PlayerDatabase, entityId: clubId, streamVersion: 1);
                      var template = new PlayerPosition[PlayerDatabaseConstants.CLUB_SQUAD_SIZE];
                      int i = 0;
                      for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) template[i++] = PlayerPosition.Goalkeeper;
                      for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) template[i++] = PlayerPosition.Defender;
                      for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) template[i++] = PlayerPosition.Midfielder;
                      while (i < template.Length) template[i++] = PlayerPosition.Forward;
                      return RosterGenerator.Generate(rng, stream, clubId, template);
                  }

                  private static MatchEngine Booted(ulong seed)
                  {
                      var engine = new MatchEngine(seed);
                      engine.ConfigureSquads(BuildSquad(seed, 1), BuildSquad(seed, 2));
                      return engine;
                  }

                  [Test]
                  public void MeasureControlledResidency()
                  {
                      long pooledControlled = 0, pooledHolder = 0, pooledBoth = 0, pooledTicks = 0;
                      foreach (ulong seed in Seeds)
                      {
                          MatchEngine engine = Booted(seed);
                          long controlled = 0, holder = 0, both = 0;
                          for (int t = 0; t < Ticks; t++)
                          {
                              engine.RunTick();
                              bool isControlled = engine.TestOnly_BallSnapshot.State == BallStateType.Controlled;
                              bool hasHolder = engine.PossessingAgentId != MatchEngineConstants.NO_POSSESSION;
                              if (isControlled) controlled++;
                              if (hasHolder) holder++;
                              if (isControlled && hasHolder) both++;
                          }
                          pooledControlled += controlled; pooledHolder += holder; pooledBoth += both; pooledTicks += Ticks;
                          TestContext.WriteLine($"CONTROLLED_RESIDENCY seed=0x{seed:X16} ticks={Ticks} controlled={controlled} controlledShare={(double)controlled / Ticks:F9} holder={holder} holderShare={(double)holder / Ticks:F9} controlledWithHolder={both} controlledWithHolderShare={(double)both / Ticks:F9}");
                      }
                      TestContext.WriteLine($"CONTROLLED_RESIDENCY pooled ticks={pooledTicks} controlled={pooledControlled} controlledShare={(double)pooledControlled / pooledTicks:F9} holder={pooledHolder} holderShare={(double)pooledHolder / pooledTicks:F9} controlledWithHolder={pooledBoth} controlledWithHolderShare={(double)pooledBoth / pooledTicks:F9}");
                      Assert.Pass("measurement complete");
                  }
              }
          }
          CS
      - name: Generate projects and restore
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - name: Run residency measurement
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          out=artifacts/pr416-no-state-machine-pair-residency
          mkdir -p "$out"
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=MeasureControlledResidency" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            --logger "trx;LogFileName=controlled-residency.trx" \
            --results-directory "$out" \
            2>&1 | tee "$out/console.log"
      - name: Upload residency evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-no-state-machine-pair-residency-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-no-state-machine-pair-residency/
          if-no-files-found: error
